name: Muslim American Society of Greater LA
mission: To nurture a balanced and living understanding of Islam for Muslims in America, raise up leaders equipped for sustained Islamic service, activate communities around prophetic principles and shared purpose, champion justice and equity in society, and engage non-Muslims with clarity and compassion about Islam as a God-centered way of life.
theoryOfChange: The Muslim American Society of Greater LA (MAS GLA) has introduced a "Theory of Change framework" and a "Strategy House" framework. The Strategy House outlines their vision, mission, and six strategic pillars: Islam to Muslims, Leadership Development, Community Mobilization, Social Justice, Islam to Non-Muslims, and Operate with Excellence. The organization has translated 92% of its programs into Theory of Change templates. The 'Our Impact Areas' page on their website details these focus areas, including subareas of focus and expected outcomes for each, demonstrating a structured approach to measuring and tracking impact.
